Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (Acme POC)

Hi Sanjeev / Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time today - appreciated the context on Acme's support automation goals. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have the same baseline: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for triage + first-draft responses for customer support (reduce TTR for Tier 1 by 25%).
- Success criteria (initial):
  - Avg latency < 350ms on 8k context for generation in our dedicated test harness
  - F1 > 0.75 on intent classification reranker against your labeled set (1k examples)
  - Subjective quality: 3 sample flows judged "acceptable" by support SMEs
- Timeline: 2-week POC starting 9/6, internal kickoff 9/7, demo + evaluation review w/ Acme week of 9/20.
- Owners: Marissa (Sales lead), Vivek (SE/implementation), Rishi (CS success metrics).

Open items we promised to follow up on:
- Provide POC MOP + checklist (Vivek) - initial draft attached.
- Confirm data export options and retention (Rishi / security follow-up).

Can you confirm the timeline still works? Also, if you want to adjust success criteria before we start, now is easiest.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Sanjeev Gupta <sanjeev@acmecorp.com>

Date: 2026-09-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (Acme POC)

Thanks Marissa - this is great. Quick note from our side after the internal alignment: we want to add a second use case into the POC scope - automated triage + suggested reply templates for billing-related tickets (about 20% of volume).

If possible we'd like the POC to show:
- Handling of billing tickets with correct retrieval of billing entity (matching to account id)
- Suggested reply templates that pass a basic policy filter (no PII leakage)

That will change the success criteria a bit (we'll need a small labeled set for billing intents, roughly 300 examples) and might add a day or two to the run. Are you open to re-baselining to include this?

Also - Elena will coordinate sample data delivery next week.

- Sanjeev
Sr. Dir. Support Ops | Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjeev Gupta <sanjeev@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (Acme POC)

Hi Sanjeev - thanks for flagging. Short answer: yes, we can scope-in the billing use case. A few clarifying Qs to make sure we propose the right evaluation plan:

1) For "billing tickets": do you want Redwood to classify + generate a template reply, or only generate suggestions for CS agents? (We can support both; evaluation differs.)
2) You mentioned account id retrieval - will that be provided in the payload or do you want Redwood to infer from text?
3) Can Elena share the 300 labeled examples by 9/8 so Vivek can add them into the test harness before the POC window?

Operationally, adding this use case implies: +3 business days to the POC window for extra data ingest/label verification and a minor update to success criteria. We'll draft a rebaseline plan and updated MOP and send over for approval by EOD tomorrow.

If that works, I'll update the timeline and owners and attach the updated checklist.

Best,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: feasibility + baseline impact for billing use case

Marissa / Rishi - quick internal note on the Ask from Acme:

- Feasibility: Solid. We can support intent classification + template generation; for account id retrieval we prefer that Acme include the account id in the payload, but we can implement a light NER/heuristic to infer it (adds ~1 day).
- Data: 300 labeled billing examples will be enough for a basic classifier and to seed template quality checks. We should validate label consistency (Elena) - suggest a quick QC pass on 50 samples.
- Impact on timeline: +3 business days for data ingestion + QC + rerun of baseline metrics. New target end-date shifts from 9/20 -> 9/23 for the evaluation review.
- Success criteria (proposed updated):
  - Core support triage: Avg latency < 350ms; F1 > 0.75 (same)
  - Billing intent subset: precision > 0.80 on billing detection (300-sample holdout)
  - Template quality: 4/5 sample billing replies rated acceptable by support SMEs

I'll put together an updated MOP and checklist (acme_poc_mop_v2.pdf and redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx) and send to Marissa to share. Stephanie - can you confirm there are no policy blockers for the billing template generation flow (PII handling)?

- Vivek
